Walk out of frame looking satisfied: Sirius Symboli

★Request
Show: Sirius Symboli (Summer Tracksuit)

■Direction
Age: High school 2nd year
Personality: Arrogant/overbearing

And yet, why? Why strive so desperately to catch up?
Why keep challenging her to duels and making "choices," no matter how many times I lose—
Getting hungry, puppy?

Up close? Then run.
Though with those fawn legs, I doubt you can keep up.

...Even when faced with words and an attitude like that,
far from minding it, the girls around her seemed delighted.

Excuse me! Sirius-senpai, your run was seriously incredible!
I won't get in your way, so can I watch up close?!

—I think that's entirely true. Looking back,
Sirius Symboli's attitude has been consistent from the very moment we met.

Yet, despite that attitude seeming completely outrageous from an outsider's view—
why am I so drawn to her back, never once turning around?

Bingo.
Looks like you're not completely hopeless at learning, are you, puppy?

To begin Sirius Symboli's training,
I checked through the regimen I'd prepared.

Even with that smirk directed at me, I had no desire to step down as her Trainer.
Though I hadn't found the reason why myself just yet—
Sirius-senpai, great work out there!!

Out of pure curiosity...
why do you go to such lengths to stay as her Trainer?

But going forward, as I get to know the Umamusume named Sirius Symboli more and more,
I'm sure I'll be able to put it into words.

Some time has passed since I became Sirius Symboli's Trainer,
and our battles over who gets to "choose" continue as usual.

...She's likely referring to our previous game of nine-ball.
Sirius Symboli smirks boldly, as if provoking me.

Oh? Plotting something, are we? Don't bother.
A puppy only gets away with their little tricks once in a lifetime.

I set aside the regimen I had prepared
and look down at the one Sirius Symboli made beneath it.
All of you, sound off! Let's go!
*Sigh*... I don't know how you manage to stay her Trainer.

"If you want me to obey, beat me."
...A simple proposition, yet an overwhelmingly difficult challenge.
Who was the one who won yesterday's match?

At first, it was her running that captivated me. I wanted to witness
that strength from up close, and in the end, I made the "choice" myself.
Missing your master?
The reason being—

And the result of my loss is today's training session.
The regimen Sirius Symboli prepared is well thought out, but—

She's intimidating, always bossing you around...
She doesn't treat you like a Trainer at all, does she?

I mean, sure, she's talented. But... is that really enough to keep following
her? In the first place, isn't the Trainer supposed to be the one leading...?

Why is that...? Usually, if someone talked like that, people would leave.
And of course, I shouldn't be an exception to that, but...

Sirius Symboli roughly ruffles my hair from behind.
As I stumble in surprise, I hear a quiet chuckle.
Move. Don't block my way.
